name: Nyne.ai
summary: People and company intelligence: person enrichment and search with contacts and social profiles, company enrichment, search, employees and funding.

api_key.description: A Nyne.ai API key (dashboard, API keys). Sent in the X-API-Key header.

api_secret.description: The secret shown once when the key was created. Sent in the X-API-Secret header.

notes: Most endpoints are asynchronous: POST answers 202 with data.request_id; GET the same path with ?request_id= until status is completed (or data.completed is true).
Rate limits per key: 100 requests a minute and 1,000 an hour, plus a monthly request quota (429 monthly_limit_exceeded).
A key is entitled per product (enrichment, search, newsfeed); a missing product answers 403 subscription_required.
Credits are checked before work starts (402 insufficient_credits) and deducted only on a meaningful result; empty results are free. Workspace prices may differ from the documented defaults.
Email and phone finders, deep research, newsfeed, employees, funding and the other person/company endpoints are documented but not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit usage
endpoints.summary: Credits consumed, allocation, remaining balance and per-API breakdown for a billing period.

month.description: Month 1-12; send with year. Omit both for the active billing period.

endpoints.name: Start a person enrichment
endpoints.summary: Full person profile (contact details, work history, social profiles, education, location) from an email, phone, profile URL or name.

name.description: Full name; at least one of email, phone, social_media_url or name is required.

city.description: City, to disambiguate a name lookup.

newsfeed.description: Social sources to also pull, e.g. ["linkedin","github"], or the string "all".

required_fields.description: Fields the result must contain to count as a match.

callback_url.description: http(s) URL that receives the finished result.

notes: A read over POST, asynchronous: answers 202 with a request_id; poll nyne.person.enrich_result.
6 credits (3 with lite_enrich), charged only when usable data comes back.

endpoints.name: Get a person enrichment result
endpoints.summary: Status and result of a person enrichment request.
notes: Poll about once a second until status is completed; polls are free but count toward rate limits.

endpoints.name: Start a people search
endpoints.summary: People matching a natural-language query and/or structured filters, optionally with emails and phones.

query.description: Natural-language description, max 1000 characters; a string, never an object.
query.example: Marketing directors at fintech startups in Austin

custom_filters.description: Structured filters: locations, titles, companies, universities, degrees, specialization_categories, industries, keywords, languages (see docs).

cursor.description: next_cursor of a previous page; send alone to submit the next page.

request_id.description: An existing search, re-sent with a new offset/limit for another page.

show_emails.description: Include verified emails (+6 credits per result).

show_phone_numbers.description: Include phone numbers (+6 credits per result).

require_emails.description: Only people with a verified email.

require_phone_numbers.description: Only people with a phone number.

insights.description: Attach why-matched evidence (+1 credit per result).

profile_scoring.description: Add a 1-5 fit score (+1 credit per result).

callback_url.description: http(s) URL that receives the finished result.

notes: A read over POST, asynchronous. The POST prepares one page and returns page metadata, not rows; read the rows with nyne.person.search_result using the same request_id, offset and limit.
1 credit per result returned, plus surcharges per result: +1 with custom_filters, +6 for email data, +6 for phone data. Do not re-POST as a status check: it can bill another page.

endpoints.name: Get a people search page
endpoints.summary: Rows of one page of a people search, once data.completed is true.

offset.description: The page's offset, as the submit returned it; defaults to 0.

limit.description: The page's limit, as the submit returned it.

notes: Keep polling while data.completed is false; completed, exhausted and stale are all terminal success. has_more and next_cursor say whether another page exists. Polling is free.

endpoints.name: Start a company enrichment
endpoints.summary: Firmographic profile (industry, headcount, locations, funding, web presence, emails, phones) from a domain, email, phone or company social URL.

social_media_url.description: Company social profile URL, e.g. LinkedIn.

callback_url.description: http(s) URL that receives the finished result.

notes: A read over POST, asynchronous: poll nyne.company.enrich_result. Charged once, only on a meaningful result; a 404 means no match and no charge.

endpoints.name: Get a company enrichment result
endpoints.summary: Status and result of a company enrichment request.

endpoints.name: Start a company search
endpoints.summary: Companies matching a natural-language query about industry, location, size, funding, investors or technologies.

query.example: pre-seed AI infrastructure startups in California with fewer than 50 employees

offset.description: 0-indexed start; use next_offset from the previous completed page.

callback_url.description: http(s) URL that receives the finished result.

notes: A read over POST, asynchronous: poll nyne.company.search_result. 1 credit per company returned.
Next page: POST the same query with offset = next_offset.

endpoints.name: Get a company search result
endpoints.summary: Status and stored page of a company search.
